observations: body L1-L26: the end of the entry on the Tāǵ al-azyāǵ, begun on p. XIII; its lines hang from the entry, and L3 begins a paragraph inside it.

body L3-L5, L9-L12, L19, L22-L23, L25: «Suter», «Yaḥyà ibn Muḥ. ibn Abī ’sh-Shukr», «Naṣīr ad-dīn», «al-Bīrūnī», «Abū» «’l-fidā’» (divided over L11-L12), «Aboul Hhassan», «Ibn Sa‘īd al-Maghrabī» and «Suteri» are letter-spaced. «Yaḥyà» ends in a with a grave accent, as the name of Ibn Sa‘īd's grandfather in note 5.
body L12: a tick between the T and the ā of «Tāǵ» is a speck; the macron stands on the ā.
body L17, L18, L20: «Málaga» has an acute accent, «Kūkawa» is followed by its Arabic name «كوكو», «Nakhčewān» has a c with a háček.
body L21, L23: the dashes measure 10.3 and 10.4 pt.
notes_left L1-L21, notes_right L1-L5: notes 1 to 3 in the left column; note 3 runs into the right column. «Brockelmann», «Nassir Eddini», «Ulug Beigi», «Lelewel» and «Oloug Beg» are letter-spaced.

notes_left L12-L19: the Greek title of the Vienna edition of 1807 is transcribed with its accents and breathings as printed, read at 1600-6000 dpi: «Νασσὶρ», «Οὐλοὺγ», «ἀραβιστὶ» with grave accents, «Μπεῖ», «ἐκδοθεῖσα» and «μεταφρασθεῖσα» with circumflexes, «ἐπιμελείᾳ» and «Βιέννῃ» with the iota subscript, «Ὤξου» with breathing and accent before the capital. The δ of «Περσίδος» prints broken, like a ζ; the κ is the open form of the type throughout.
notes_right L10: the dash of «134–41» is a long dash (6.1 pt); the hyphens of the notes measure 2.9-4.2 pt.
notes_right L11: the r of «Nūṛ» is printed with a dot below, as a ṛ; transcribed as printed (the name is Nūr ad-dīn).
notes_right L17: «cxli», «cxliii», «cccxvi» and «cccxix» are small capitals.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
